content.context: Pitmry dashboard enhancement for skills customization, open-source repository bundling, and accessible typography.
content.decision: Embedded starter skills and Python automation scripts directly in the repository with adaptive machine topology discovery (AGENTS_SKILLS_PATH, ~/.agents/skills, .agents/skills) and .bak revert capability.
content.rationale: Users need an open-source, customizable environment to manage agent skills and automation workflows locally, with safety guardrails against script corruption and accessible UI controls.
